title: Close every in-memory Drift UserDatabase created by gamification test factories
rule: TQ-6 hermetic tests / drift_memory.dart's own documented contract
why: test/helpers/drift_memory.dart documents: 'Callers MUST await db.close() in tearDown to free the native resources.' These 7 factory call sites (used by ~1041+709+9+3 individual test invocations respectively) never do, so every test run leaves a live FFI-backed sqlite3 in-memory connection open until the file's isolate exits. 6 other files in this same batch (child_redemption_balance_reactive_test.dart, child_redemption_rewards_staleness_test.dart, pending_redemptions_reactive_test.dart, parent_pending_redemptions_screen_l1_test.dart, r_ga2_...test.dart, and 7 of 9 sites in child_redemption_screen_l1_test.dart) follow the contract correctly, proving it's practical here and making the gap inconsistent rather than structural.
recommendation: Route each factory through addTearDown(db.close) (or the setUp/tearDown pattern parent_pending_redemptions_screen_l1_test.dart already uses correctly) so every inMemoryDb()/createTestUserDatabase() call in this feature is closed.
acceptance_criteria: grep-based Rule-0 checker: every `inMemoryDb()`/`createTestUserDatabase()` call site under test/ has a matching close() reachable from the same scope.
The 7 cited call sites each gain an addTearDown(..., .close) or equivalent.
